_comment: Copy to scripts/e2e-seed.local.json (gitignored) and fill in your own values. The seed copies real session logs from your $DSH_HOME into an isolated e2e home; sessions must exist in the source home. 'targetSessionTitle' (optional) names the live session row scripts/e2e-live.mjs drives.
targetSessionTitle: <a session row title you will keep opening during the test>
